task: Fill and frame the prairie foreground
hypothesis: Overlapping grass, seedhead, flower and low-shrub pockets at the lateral foreground provide a natural frame while low cover connects into a readable staging opening.
scope: One prairie-only dressing file. Retained tree specimens, terrain, camera, lighting and grass representation. Existing middle communities keep their own unchanged random streams.

review.reviewer: Primary Codex actual hero and elevated screenshot interpretation
observations: Both lateral foreground edges are now occupied by dimensional grass and flower silhouettes instead of mostly empty substrate.
Patch overlap and varied heights connect the side framing into existing middle shrubs.
Center remains readable; low plants soften the opening without a raised or circular clearing.
Grass pigmentation is still pale and uniform; this is not final concept fidelity.

staging.limitation: Bounds detector for dressing, not character physics or exact triangle collision; low cover is deliberately traversable.

validation.limitation: Root-position exclusions and image inspection are not character-physics certification. No mobile-device approval or broad regression suite.
